correctness.rationale: Averaging over simultaneous graph automorphisms and the layer swap preserves all constraints and does not increase the convex spectral norm. The two-layer Laplacian decomposition gives exactly the three scalar spectral endpoints; zero diagonal imposes d x+y=1 and reduces their maximum to max{1-delta x, 2d x-1} on 0<=x<=1/d. Their intersection gives the asserted minimizer, with bipartiteness proving the periodic boundary. A separate inequality-and-attainment proof gives the holding-allowed reference value and the exact rational penalty. The standalone Python verifier completed 1,177 exact assertions, including independent characteristic-polynomial reconstruction by Newton power sums. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the general result.

originality.rationale: An exact global zero-diagonal optimization is established for all connected vertex-and-edge-transitive base graphs. The 2007 general convex and Cartesian symmetry results do not assert this loopless optimum; their known holding-allowed formula is an antecedent. The loopless cyclic-prism case is already included in prior work and is not claimed separately. A 2024 paper treats precisely the matched-clique example but proves only an order-of-magnitude gap, not the exact no-holding weights or universal spectral-penalty formula. The proof distinguishes existing zero-penalty thresholds from the new quantified positive penalty and optimal loopless design; unindexed specialist coverage remains a risk.

value.rationale: Disallowing self-transitions is a natural transition-system and consensus constraint. The holding-allowed solution can violate it, so the constrained optimum must be determined rather than reused. The exact all-graph theorem yields implementable per-edge weights and a quantitative price of no holding, including an explicitly nonzero O(1/m) penalty on matched cliques and a sharp phase transition in Johnson bases. It establishes a substantive universal spectral tradeoff rather than a finite table, parameter renaming or unsourced performance claim.
